picks.thesis: The bear call spread offers a solid 0.26 credit on a 1‑point width (credit‑to‑width = 0.26) with the short call at delta 0.2518, right in the middle of the ideal band, and low IV (12.8%).
The bull put spread provides the highest credit‑to‑width ratio (0.27) among the list, with the short put at delta ‑0.3282 (still acceptable) and IV around 20%, making it a strong one‑day credit play.
